entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 3266, Standbuch 1011, Folio: 328v, Schreiber: Lorenz Fries
entries.german: Furter sein die gemelten schloss vnd marckt Haldenbergstetten erblich an die von Rosenberg komen, vnd hat her Zaisolf von Rosenberg [gestrichen: xvi c fl] von B Conraden des geschlechts von Thungen genomen, vnd die bede dem stiffte W. vfgeben, zu lehen gemacht vnd entpfangen am Montag nach Conuersionis Pauli anno 1520 Recepta in primo feudorum Conradi fo 62. [Nachtragshand am Rand: Munster, Jrmershausen, Treuschwingen hoff, Reihbach hoff, haldenhoff] Kommentar: Die Nachtragshand ergänzt die Orte: Münster ( Munster ), Jrmershausen , Treuschwingen hoff , Reihbach hoff und haldenhoff .
entries.english: Furthermore, the aforesaid castle and market of Haltenbergstetten had passed hereditarily to the von Rosenbergs. Zaisolph von Rosenberg, Herr, received 1,600 florins from Konrad von Thüngen, Bischof, surrendered the two properties to the bishopric of Würzburg, and received them back as a fief on the Monday after the Conversion of St Paul, 1520. Recorded in the first register of Conrad’s fiefs, fol. 62. Marginal addition: Münster, Irmershausen, Treuschwinden farm, Reihbach farm, Haldenhof. Editorial note: The later hand adds these place names.

facts.subject: von Rosenberg family
facts.content: inherited Schloss and the market of Haltenbergstetten.
surrendered Schloss and the market of Haltenbergstetten to Bishop Konrad von Thüngen and received them back as a fief.
